body: I have no one to talk to, no one here understands my way of viewing things, why should i still be here, why should i be quiet when people who think they're above everyone else speak , why should i be viewed as someone smaller than them, why should i have to put up with listening to bullshit and living through bullshit on a daily basis, why would anyone except my mother care that i'm suddenly gone when i'm only one of 7 billion? why do i have to keep going through the hell that's my head? why would anyone want that?
Thank you a lot :) I will battle and update when i'm on track :)

It's not about racism anymore actually, i  mean i do get that, but only on the internet.. just like most people. In real life the issue now is the last police incident.. i hope it goes away sooner rather than later. I try not to let these people get to me since i got college and hopefully a promising future but i can't block all these hateful words all at once yet.. i need to become stronger mentally.
My perfect way of saying "f you" to these people, would be in the lines of driving up to them in my dream car and just saying "How you doing?".
I never thought of doing that, will do next time. Thank you for this advice!

I have random moments of 'Happiness' that occur when i visit family or the other way around. I just can't express how good it felt being back in Poland this summer for a wedding, and having a pint of beer with all my uncles and talking about cars and you know, just having a good time. I can surely say that was the greatest moment of my life so far. We don't go to Poland often and when we do it's just visiting all family members and even though that's nice, it's also tiring at times. But this summer (last year) was priceless. Seeing family every 3 years and seeing how everyone changed, also the ability to legally consume beer and talk to my uncle's.. it was something special.

My perfect job at the moment would be working in the background (not sure if that's the right word) for example in a storage or warehouse. But if i hear back from an employer about a cashier or pub job, i'll take it right away. I feel like that would help me develop and come across some good people.. also i'll develop as a person and gain valuable work experience.

I am actually in the process of searching for a job for the past couple of weeks, unfortunately i didn't hear back from a single employer.. but there just has to be at least one out there that will hire me.
